g.text: Work/free day: Time below 1 lx melEDI

Adjustment factor = full site-specific comparison/reference ratio ÷ equal-site comparison/reference ratio
Site deviations from the equal-site context association
Points and bars are adjustment factors with pointwise 95% confidence intervals.
Values below 1 indicate a weaker site-specific comparison/reference ratio than the equal-site contrast; values above 1 indicate a stronger ratio.
Intervals are descriptive localizations after a globally FDR-supported interaction and are not multiplicity adjusted across the nine sites.
